hindi: अब इसके बाद हम 'दीर्घंजीवितीय' नामक अध्याय की व्याख्या करेंगे।
english: Now, therefore, we shall expound the chapter called "Dīrghaṃjīvitīya" (On Long Life).
notes: Prose opening formula, not a verse (the unit is typed as "verse"). dīrghañjīvitīya is a taddhita name formed from the chapter's opening words dīrghaṃ jīvitam.

hindi: ऐसा भगवान् आत्रेय ने कहा था।
english: Thus spoke the venerable Ātreya.
notes: Prose formula, not a verse. sma with āha gives a past sense.

words.gram: pres. part. m. nom. sg. anu-√iṣ

hindi: दीर्घ जीवन की इच्छा करते हुए उग्र तपस्या वाले भरद्वाज, देवताओं के स्वामी इन्द्र को शरण देने वाला जानकर, उनके पास गए।
english: Seeking long life, Bharadvāja, of fierce austerity, approached Indra, knowing him to be the lord of the immortals who gives refuge.
notes: bharadvāja upāgamat: visarga of bharadvājaḥ dropped before a vowel (regular sandhi).

hindi: ब्रह्मा ने आयुर्वेद को जैसा कहा था, वैसा ही सबसे पहले प्रजापति ने उसे सम्पूर्ण रूप में ग्रहण किया; फिर उनसे अश्विनीकुमारों ने ग्रहण किया।
english: For Prajāpati first received Āyurveda (the science of life) in full, just as Brahmā had declared it; and from him, in turn, the two Aśvins (received it).

text_flags.why: missing r: pajāpati is not a word; the sense (the line of transmission Brahmā > Prajāpati > Aśvins) and metre require prajāpatiḥ; only the letter r is lost, the syllable count is unchanged

notes: The verb of the second clause (aśvinau ... tataḥ) is understood from jagrāha. yathāproktam can be read adverbially ("exactly as declared") or as an adjective of āyurvedam.

words.gram: m. nom. sg. ppp pra-√vac, tat-puruṣa

hindi: अश्विनीकुमारों से भगवान् इन्द्र ने उसे पूर्ण रूप से प्राप्त किया; इसलिए ऋषियों के कहने पर भरद्वाज इन्द्र के पास गए।
english: From the Aśvins the lord Śakra (Indra) received it in its entirety; therefore Bharadvāja, urged by the sages, approached Śakra.
notes: kevalam may mean "entirely" (as taken) or "alone, only"; taken adverbially. ṛṣiproktaḥ literally "spoken to by the sages", i.e. requested by them (see units 17-19).

words.gloss: of austerity, fasting, study, celibacy, vows and life

hindi: जब देहधारियों में रोग उत्पन्न हुए, जो उनके तप, उपवास, अध्ययन, ब्रह्मचर्य, व्रत और आयु में विघ्न बन गए,
english: When diseases arose among embodied beings, becoming obstacles to their austerity, fasting, study, celibacy, vows and life,
notes: The sentence continues into unit 7. The genitive compound in line 2 can depend on vighna (obstacles to austerity...) or stand in apposition to śarīriṇām (embodied beings whose austerity... ); the sense is the same. tapopavāsa for tapa-upavāsa (tapas shortened to tapa- in compound) is the usual reading, not flagged.

hindi: तब प्राणियों के प्रति करुणा को आगे रखकर पुण्य कर्म करने वाले महर्षि हिमालय के शुभ पार्श्व में एकत्र हुए।
english: then the great sages of virtuous deeds, putting compassion for living beings first, assembled on an auspicious slope of the Himālaya.
notes: Continues the sentence of unit 6.

hindi: अङ्गिरा, जमदग्नि, वसिष्ठ, कश्यप, भृगु, आत्रेय, गौतम, सांख्य, पुलस्त्य, नारद, असित,
english: Aṅgiras, Jamadagni, Vasiṣṭha, Kaśyapa, Bhṛgu, Ātreya, Gautama, Sāṅkhya, Pulastya, Nārada, Asita,
notes: List of the assembled sages, continuing to unit 13. sāṅkhyaḥ may be a personal name or "the Sāṅkhya (teacher)"; kept as a name.

hindi: अगस्त्य, वामदेव, मार्कण्डेय और आश्वलायन, पारिक्षि, भिक्षु आत्रेय, भरद्वाज, कपिञ्जल,
english: Agastya, Vāmadeva, Mārkaṇḍeya and Āśvalāyana, Pārikṣi, Bhikṣu Ātreya, Bharadvāja, Kapiñjala,
notes: bhikṣur ātreyaḥ is taken as "Ātreya the mendicant" (Bhikṣu Ātreya), distinct from the Ātreya of unit 8. Some editions read pārīkṣi for pārikṣi; kept as printed.

hindi: विश्वामित्र और आश्मरथ्य, भार्गव च्यवन, अभिजित्, गार्ग्य, शाण्डिल्य और कौण्डिल्य, वार्क्षि, देवल और गालव,
english: Viśvāmitra and Āśmarathya, Cyavana the Bhārgava, Abhijit, Gārgya, Śāṇḍilya and Kauṇḍilya, Vārkṣi, Devala and Gālava,

text_flags.why: word space missing after the dual ending -au (spacing only; the reading is unchanged)

notes: bhārgavaś cyavanaḥ taken as one person (Cyavana, descendant of Bhṛgu); it could also be read as two names.

hindi: सांकृत्य, बैजवापि, कुशिक, बादरायण, बडिश, शरलोमा, और काप्य तथा कात्यायन दोनों,
english: Sāṅkṛtya, Baijavāpi, Kuśika, Bādarāyaṇa, Baḍiśa, Śaraloman, and both Kāpya and Kātyāyana,

hindi: काङ्कायन, कैकशेय, धौम्य, मारीच और काश्यप, शर्कराक्ष, हिरण्याक्ष, लोकाक्ष और पैङ्गि भी,
english: Kāṅkāyana, Kaikaśeya, Dhaumya, Mārīca and Kāśyapa, Śarkarākṣa, Hiraṇyākṣa, Lokākṣa, and Paiṅgi too,
notes: mārīcakāśyapau is a dual, so two persons (Mārīca and Kāśyapa) are named.

hindi: शौनक, शाकुनेय, मैत्रेय, मैमतायनि, वैखानस, वालखिल्य तथा अन्य महर्षि भी,
english: Śaunaka, Śākuneya, Maitreya, Maimatāyani, the Vaikhānasas, the Vālakhilyas, and likewise other great sages,
notes: vaikhānasāḥ and vālakhilyāḥ are plural: groups of ascetics, not single persons. The list ends here; the description continues in unit 14.

words.gram: m. nom. pl. pres. pass. part. √hu

hindi: जो ब्रह्मज्ञान, दम और नियम के भण्डार थे, और तप के तेज से आहुति पाती अग्नियों के समान दीप्त थे,
english: treasuries of the knowledge of brahman, of self-control and of discipline, blazing with the radiance of austerity like fires receiving oblations,
notes: tapasaḥ is taken with tejasā ("radiance of austerity"); it could also be a further genitive with nidhayaḥ ("treasuries ... of austerity"), with tejasā alone meaning "with radiance".

words.gloss: of dharma, wealth, pleasure and liberation

hindi: वहाँ सुखपूर्वक बैठकर उन्होंने यह पवित्र चर्चा की: "धर्म, अर्थ, काम और मोक्ष का उत्तम मूल आरोग्य है।
english: Seated at ease there, they held this sacred discussion: "Health is the supreme root of dharma, wealth (artha), pleasure (kāma) and liberation (mokṣa).
notes: The sages' direct speech runs from line 2 here to "ity uktvā" in unit 17.

words.gram: m. nom. pl. agent noun apa-√hṛ

hindi: रोग इस आरोग्य के, कल्याण के और जीवन के भी नाशक हैं। मनुष्यों के सामने यह बड़ी बाधा उत्पन्न हो गई है।
english: Diseases are the destroyers of this (health), of well-being and of life. This great obstacle has arisen for human beings.
notes: tasya is taken as referring to ārogya (health) of unit 15.

hindi: इनके शमन का क्या उपाय हो सकता है?" ऐसा कहकर वे ध्यान में स्थित हो गए; तब उन्होंने ध्यान की दृष्टि से इन्द्र को शरण के रूप में देखा।
english: What could be the means of allaying them?" Having said this, they entered into meditation; then, with the eye of meditation, they saw Śakra as their refuge.
notes: śamopāya: visarga of -upāyaḥ dropped before i (regular sandhi). teṣām refers to the diseases.

hindi: "देवताओं के स्वामी वे ही शमन का उपाय ठीक-ठीक बताएँगे। शचीपति से पूछने के लिए सहस्राक्ष के भवन में कौन जाए?"
english: "He, the lord of the immortals, will tell us properly the means of allaying them. Who should go to the abode of the thousand-eyed one to ask the husband of Śacī?"
notes: Sahasrākṣa (thousand-eyed) and Śacīpati (husband of Śacī) are epithets of Indra.

words.gram: m. nom. sg. ppp caus. ni-√yuj

hindi: "इस कार्य के लिए मुझे नियुक्त किया जाए", यह वचन भरद्वाज ने सबसे पहले कहा; इसलिए ऋषियों ने उन्हें ही नियुक्त किया।
english: "Let me be appointed for this task," was the first word, spoken by Bharadvāja; therefore he was appointed by the sages.

words.gloss: being amid the hosts of gods and sages

words.gram: m. acc. sg. pres. part. mid. √dīp

hindi: इन्द्र के भवन में जाकर उन्होंने देवताओं और ऋषियों के समूह के मध्य स्थित, अग्नि के समान दीप्त, बल के संहारक इन्द्र को देखा।
english: Having gone to Śakra's abode, he saw the slayer of Bala, seated amid the hosts of gods and sages, blazing like fire.
notes: surarṣi may be a dvandva "gods and sages" (as taken) or a karmadhāraya "divine sages". Balahantṛ, "slayer of (the demon) Bala", is an epithet of Indra.

hindi: उन बुद्धिमान ने पास जाकर विजय के आशीर्वादों से देवेश्वर का अभिनन्दन किया और विनयपूर्वक ऋषियों का उत्तम वचन कहा:
english: He approached, greeted the lord of the gods with blessings of victory, and, being wise, humbly delivered the sages' excellent message:

text_flags.why: dental s for retroflex ṣ: the genitive plural of ṛṣi is ṛṣīṇām (same word appears correctly elsewhere in the chunk)

hindi: "सब प्राणियों को भयभीत करने वाले रोग उत्पन्न हो गए हैं; अतः हे देवताओं के स्वामी, मुझे उनके शमन का उपाय ठीक-ठीक बताइए।"
english: "Diseases have arisen that terrify all living beings; so tell me properly the means of allaying them, O lord of the immortals."

hindi: उनकी विशाल बुद्धि को जानकर भगवान् शतक्रतु इन्द्र ने उन परम ऋषि को थोड़े शब्दों में आयुर्वेद का उपदेश दिया।
english: To him, the supreme sage, the lord Śatakratu (Indra), perceiving his vast intellect, taught Āyurveda in few words.
notes: Śatakratu, "of a hundred sacrifices", is an epithet of Indra.

words.gloss: knowledge of cause, sign and remedy
words.gram: n. acc. sg. tat-puruṣa (dvandva first member)

words.gloss: the support of the healthy and the sick

hindi: यह वही हेतु, लिङ्ग और औषध का ज्ञान है, जो स्वस्थ और रोगी दोनों का परम आश्रय है, जो तीन सूत्रों वाला, शाश्वत और पुण्य है, और जिसे पितामह ब्रह्मा ने जाना था।
english: It is the knowledge of cause (hetu), sign (liṅga) and remedy (auṣadha), the support of both the healthy and the sick, the eternal and sacred threefold teaching (trisūtra), which the Grandsire (Brahmā) had understood.
notes: Apposition to āyurvedam of unit 23. The relative yam is masculine (agreeing with āyurveda, m.) while the adjectives are neuter (agreeing with jñānam); this mixed agreement is in the text and not flagged. pitāmaha "Grandsire" is taken as Brahmā (cf. unit 4).

hindi: उन महाबुद्धि मुनि ने उसमें मन लगाकर, अनन्त विस्तार वाले, तीन स्कन्धों वाले सम्पूर्ण आयुर्वेद को शीघ्र ही यथावत् समझ लिया।
english: That sage of great intellect, his mind intent on it, soon understood properly the whole of Āyurveda, limitless in extent and having three branches (triskandha).

words.gram: pres. part. caus. m. nom. sg. ava-√śiṣ with neg. an-

hindi: उसके द्वारा भरद्वाज ने सुख से युक्त अपरिमित आयु प्राप्त की; और उन्होंने उसे बिना कुछ बढ़ाए और बिना कुछ छोड़े ऋषियों को बताया।
english: Through it Bharadvāja obtained a boundless life filled with happiness; and he taught it to the sages exactly, adding nothing and leaving nothing out.

text_flags.why: extra i: sukha-anvitam "endowed with happiness"; sukhānivitam is not a word and has one syllable too many for the 8-syllable quarter

notes: amitam and anadhikam are printed with m before a consonant (for ṃ); this is an orthographic variant, not a reading difference, and is not flagged. anadhikam "not exceeding" with anavaśeṣayan "leaving nothing out" gives the sense "exactly".

words.gram: m. nom. pl. desid. pres. part. √kṛ

hindi: और दीर्घ आयु की इच्छा करते हुए ऋषियों ने भरद्वाज से प्रजा के लिए हितकारी, आयु को बढ़ाने वाले उस वेद को ग्रहण किया।
english: And the sages, wishing to secure long life, received from Bharadvāja that science (veda), beneficial to creatures and the promoter of life.
notes: veda here means "science, knowledge" (the Āyurveda), not one of the four Vedas. vardhanam is used as an adjective of vedam.

hindi: उन महर्षियों ने ज्ञान की दृष्टि से सामान्य, विशेष, गुण, द्रव्य और कर्म को यथावत् देखा,
english: Those great sages saw properly, with the eye of knowledge, the general (sāmānya) and the particular (viśeṣa), qualities (guṇa), substances (dravya) and action (karma),

text_flags.why: garbled typing (ḍ for d and r for ṛ): the perfect 3 pl. of √dṛś is dadṛśuḥ, as in unit 17

notes: The sentence continues into unit 29 (samavāya). These are the six categories later known from Vaiśeṣika; the text simply lists them.

hindi: और समवाय को भी; इन्हें जानकर तथा तन्त्र में कहे गए विधान का पालन करके उन्होंने परम सुख और चिरस्थायी जीवन प्राप्त किया।
english: and inherence (samavāya); knowing these and following the regimen stated in the treatise, they obtained the highest well-being and a life that does not soon pass away.
notes: yat (singular) refers to the whole set of categories in units 28-29. anitvara "not transient" is rendered "that does not soon pass away".

words.gram: past act. part. m. nom. sg. √dā

words.gloss: out of compassion for all beings

hindi: तब मैत्री में तत्पर पुनर्वसु ने सब प्राणियों पर अनुकम्पा के कारण वह पुण्य आयुर्वेद छह शिष्यों को दिया।
english: Then Punarvasu, devoted to friendliness, out of compassion for all beings gave the sacred Āyurveda to six disciples.

hindi: अग्निवेश, भेल, जतूकर्ण, पराशर, हारीत और क्षारपाणि ने उन मुनि के वचन को ग्रहण किया।
english: Agniveśa, Bhela, Jatūkarṇa, Parāśara, Hārīta and Kṣārapāṇi received the sage's teaching.
notes: These are the six disciples of unit 30.

hindi: उनमें अन्तर बुद्धि की विशेषता का था, मुनि के उपदेश में कोई भेद नहीं था; इसी कारण अग्निवेश सबसे पहले तन्त्र के रचयिता हुए।
english: The difference among them lay in their intellect, not in any difference in the sage's teaching; that is why Agniveśa became the first author of a treatise (tantra).

hindi: तब भेल आदि ने अपने-अपने तन्त्र रचे, और उन मेधावी शिष्यों ने अपनी रचनाएँ ऋषि-समूह सहित आत्रेय को सुनाईं।
english: Then Bhela and the others each composed his own treatise, and these intelligent ones recited their compositions to Ātreya together with the assembly of sages.
notes: kṛtāni "the things composed" is the object of śrāvayāmāsuḥ; sarṣisaṅgham qualifies ātreyam ("Ātreya with the assembly of sages").

hindi: पुण्यकर्मा शिष्यों द्वारा विषयों का सूत्ररूप में किया गया संयोजन सुनकर ऋषि प्रसन्न हुए और "यह ठीक प्रकार से सूत्रित है" कहकर उन्होंने उनका अनुमोदन किया।
english: Hearing the arrangement of the topics in sūtras by those of virtuous deeds, the sages were delighted and approved of them, saying, "It is properly set out in sūtras."
notes: puṇyakarmaṇām (gen. pl.) refers to the disciples who composed the works; tān "them" refers to the disciples (or their works).

hindi: सब ने ही सब प्राणियों का हित चाहने वाले उन शिष्यों की प्रशंसा की, और एक साथ ऊँचे स्वर में कहा: "धन्य है, प्राणियों के प्रति यह करुणा!"
english: All of them praised those well-wishers of all beings, and cried aloud together, "Well done! Here is compassion for living beings!"
notes: sarvabhūtahitaiṣiṇaḥ is taken as acc. pl. with tān (the disciples); it can also be nom. pl. describing the praising sages. sarva for sarve: e becomes a before the vowel of eva (regular sandhi).

hindi: स्वर्ग में स्थित देवर्षियों ने परम ऋषियों का वह पुण्य शब्द सुना, और देवताओं सहित उसे सुनकर वे अत्यन्त प्रसन्न हुए।
english: The divine sages abiding in heaven heard that holy cry of the supreme sages, and, together with the gods, hearing it they rejoiced greatly.

text_flags.why: short a for long ā: the genitive plural ending is -īṇām
